description: Single source of truth for topic-first progression and reusable cross-topic foundations.

foundations.title: Numbers
foundations.description: Cardinals, quantities and large numbers reused in prices, time, family, transport and ordering.

foundations.title: Counters
foundations.description: Reusable Japanese counters introduced where their objects first become useful.

foundations.title: Colours
foundations.description: Introduced once and reused in clothes, food, nature, objects and descriptions.

foundations.title: Days & Dates
foundations.description: Days, months and dates reused in school, work, plans, travel and events.

foundations.title: Time
foundations.description: Clock time and duration reused in routines, transport, work, school and appointments.

foundations.title: Question Words
foundations.description: What, who, where, when, why, which and how reused across conversations.

foundations.title: Directions & Position
foundations.description: Location and movement language reused in home, shopping, travel and hotels.

foundations.title: People & Pronouns
foundations.description: People, roles and pronouns reused across every social topic.

foundations.title: Core Verbs
foundations.description: High-frequency actions repeatedly practised in different real situations.

foundations.title: Core Descriptions
foundations.description: Common adjective concepts reused across people, objects, food, weather and feelings.

foundations.title: Particles & Connectors
foundations.description: Structural language reused in sentences, grammar, stories and conversations.

foundations.title: Polite Expressions
foundations.description: Greetings and polite phrases reused in shops, restaurants, work, travel and introductions.
